Hi team — taking ownership on the billing side. TL;DR: portal primary + email copies during ramp. Details below and next steps.

1) Channel: We prefer to use our portal (single source of truth, structured metadata, and secure VAT uploads). We'll make NexaHealth the primary recipient in portal and push a PDF copy by email to billing@nexahealth.com until portal onboarding completes. That approach keeps AP systems happy and ensures they receive immediate copies.

2) Onboarding ETA: we can provision a NexaHealth portal tenant and send an invite within 5 business days. Portal activation + SSO/credentials typically takes 10–15 business days in total; plan for ~3 weeks to full portal-only delivery.

3) VAT evidence: Portal supports one-time VAT document upload (PDF) that we then link to all subsequent invoices. If Nexa requires the VAT attestation file to be embedded in the invoice PDF itself, we can include a one-page VAT annex on each invoice during the initial 2 invoice cycles. After the portal is active we'll reference the uploaded certificate. Please confirm preference.

4) PO handling & XML: We will accept GF-771 as a PO reference. For AP integration, attached is an example XML payload and a short PO validation guide (two example PO formats). The XML reflects the invoice payload our ERP currently emits — fields: invoice_id, issue_date, line_items (taxable flags), buyer_reference (PO), and tax_summary. Let us know if you need a different schema.

5) Next steps I recommend: 
- Sarah: confirm whether NexaHealth wants a per-invoice VAT PDF or portal upload (we can do either).
- Connor: I'll need the specific billing contact email and the name to seed the portal invitation.
- We'll open a short onboarding ticket (DN-9421) and attach the sample XML and PO guide.

Attachments: invoice_xml_sample.xml, po-validation-examples.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0333
